title: Tensor product of pro-étale sheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category with a closed symmetric monoidal
structure $(\otimes,\mathbf 1)$. Examples are $\mathcal A=\Mod_R$ for a commutative
ring $R$, and $\mathcal A=\Ab$ with the tensor product $M\otimes N=M\otimes_{\mathbf Z}N$,
unit $\mathbf Z$ and internal hom the group $\Hom(M,N)$. For $\Ab$ this is the monoidal
structure used throughout, *not* the cartesian one.

Let $C$ be a site whose underlying category is essentially small, relative to the size of
the morphism groups of $\mathcal A$. Examples are the small pro-étale site
$X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ of a scheme $X$ ([def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]) and the category of
profinite sets with the coherent topology. Write $\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$ for the category of
$\mathcal A$-valued sheaves on $C$ and $a$ for sheafification.

The *tensor product* of $\mathcal F,\mathcal G\in\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$ is the sheafification
of the objectwise tensor product,

$$
\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal G:=a\bigl(U\longmapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes\mathcal G(U)\bigr),
$$

with unit the sheafified constant presheaf $a(\underline{\mathbf 1})$. Then:

1. this is a symmetric monoidal structure on $\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$, and sheafification from
   $\mathcal A$-valued presheaves with the objectwise tensor product is a strong symmetric
   monoidal functor;
2. the structure is closed: every functor $\mathcal F\otimes-$ has a right adjoint
   $\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,-)$. Hence $\mathcal F\otimes-$ and $-\otimes\mathcal F$
   preserve colimits, and in particular they are right exact.

For $\mathcal A=\Ab$, the tensor product of abelian sheaves is the sheafified objectwise
$\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$, with unit the constant sheaf $\underline{\mathbf Z}$.

proof.text: The additivity hypothesis in the supporting presheaf node adds no assumption here. Closedness gives a right adjoint to $L=M\otimes-$, and symmetry gives one to $-\otimes M$. By [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits], each preserves the zero object and finite coproducts. In an abelian category these are biproducts. Under the canonical identification $L(X\oplus Y)=LX\oplus LY$, zero morphisms and injections are preserved, so the projections are preserved too, as their composites with the injections are the identity and zero maps. Consequently diagonals and codiagonals are preserved, and the biproduct formula $f+g=\nabla\circ(f\oplus g)\circ\Delta$ shows that $L(f+g)=L(f)+L(g)$. Thus tensor is additive in each variable, and [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf] applies with exactly the coefficient hypotheses of the item. It supplies the objectwise closed symmetric monoidal presheaf category and the natural adjunction $\operatorname{Hom}(F\otimes_pG,H)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(G,[F,H])$. The essentially small site is taken relative to the Hom universe of $\mathcal A$, and the end in that supporting node is taken in this universe.

source.place: Presheaves paragraph; additivity implicit in the closed coefficient hypothesis

proof.text: Write $\iota$ for the full inclusion of sheaves and $a\dashv\iota$ for the sheafification adjunction [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with unit $\eta_P:P\to\iota aP$. Let $W$ be the sheafification-isomorphisms, with the equivalent Hom characterization of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-local-iso]. For a presheaf $F$ and a sheaf $H$, [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-hom-sheaf] says that $[F,\iota H]$ is a sheaf. The natural adjunction of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf] identifies $\operatorname{Hom}(F\otimes_pg,\iota H)$ with $\operatorname{Hom}(g,[F,\iota H])$, which is bijective when $g\in W$. Thus $F\otimes_pg\in W$. For $g:X\to Y$, naturality of the presheaf symmetry gives $g\otimes_pF=\beta_{F,Y}\circ(F\otimes_pg)\circ\beta_{X,F}$; applying $a$ shows that this map also lies in $W$. Precomposition with $\eta_P$ is bijective on maps to every sheaf, by the sheafification universal property, so $\eta_P\in W$. The map $\eta_F\otimes_p\eta_G$ factors as $(\iota aF\otimes_p\eta_G)\circ(\eta_F\otimes_pG)$. Both factors lie in $W$, and their composite does because $a$ is a functor. Hence $a(\eta_F\otimes_p\eta_G):a(F\otimes_pG)\to a(\iota aF\otimes_p\iota aG)$ is the natural isomorphism of clause 3 of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-local-iso].

source.place: Monoidal structure on sheaves paragraph: stability of W under tensor and units

proof.text: Use the tensor, unit and associator specified in [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure]: the tensor is $a(\iota\mathcal F\otimes_p\iota\mathcal G)$, its map on morphisms is $a(\varphi\otimes_p\psi)$, and its unit is $a(\underline{\mathbf 1})$. Its associator is the displayed composite in that node, using the comparisons of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-local-iso] and the objectwise associator of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf]. Write $\epsilon_{\mathcal F}:a\iota\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ for the map corresponding to $\mathrm{id}_{\iota\mathcal F}$ under [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. It satisfies $\iota\epsilon_{\mathcal F}\circ\eta_{\iota\mathcal F}=\mathrm{id}$. The two endomorphisms $\eta_{\iota\mathcal F}\circ\iota\epsilon_{\mathcal F}$ and $\mathrm{id}$ of the sheaf $\iota a\iota\mathcal F$ agree after precomposition with $\eta_{\iota\mathcal F}$, so the uniqueness in the universal property makes them equal. Thus $\epsilon_{\mathcal F}$ is invertible. The left unitor is the composite $a(\iota a\underline{\mathbf 1}\otimes_p\iota\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{a(\eta_{\underline{\mathbf 1}}\otimes_p\mathrm{id})^{-1}}a(\underline{\mathbf 1}\otimes_p\iota\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{a(\lambda)}a\iota\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\epsilon_{\mathcal F}}\mathcal F$. The right unitor is $a(\iota\mathcal F\otimes_p\iota a\underline{\mathbf 1})\xrightarrow{a(\mathrm{id}\otimes_p\eta_{\underline{\mathbf 1}})^{-1}}a(\iota\mathcal F\otimes_p\underline{\mathbf 1})\xrightarrow{a(\rho)}a\iota\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\epsilon_{\mathcal F}}\mathcal F$. Here $\lambda,\rho$ are the objectwise unitors, and the inverted maps are invertible by tensor stability of $W$. The symmetry is $a(\beta_{\iota\mathcal F,\iota\mathcal G})$. These are the structure maps in [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure], whose conclusion supplies their coherence identities and the strong symmetric monoidality of $a$. Its tensor comparison is the inverse of $a(\eta_F\otimes_p\eta_G)$, namely $aF\otimes aG=a(\iota aF\otimes_p\iota aG)\cong a(F\otimes_pG)$, and its unit comparison is the identity on $a(\underline{\mathbf 1})$. This proves clause 1 for precisely the tensor and unit in the statement.

source.place: Monoidal structure on sheaves paragraph: descent, coherence, and strong symmetric monoidality

proof.text: For sheaves $\mathcal F,\mathcal H$, take $\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,\mathcal H)=[\iota\mathcal F,\iota\mathcal H]$, which is a sheaf by [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-hom-sheaf]. The adjunction [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], the natural presheaf adjunction [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf], and fullness of the sheaf category give, for every sheaf $\mathcal G$, the natural chain $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Sh}}(a(\iota\mathcal F\otimes_p\iota\mathcal G),\mathcal H)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PSh}}(\iota\mathcal F\otimes_p\iota\mathcal G,\iota\mathcal H)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PSh}}(\iota\mathcal G,[\iota\mathcal F,\iota\mathcal H])=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Sh}}(\mathcal G,\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,\mathcal H))$. This exhibits the right adjoint and is the adjunction of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-closed]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits] to obtain preservation of colimits by $\mathcal F\otimes-$. For the other variable, the natural symmetry specified in [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure] identifies the image of any colimit cocone under $-\otimes\mathcal F$ with its image under $\mathcal F\otimes-$: each component $D_j\otimes\mathcal F\to\mathcal F\otimes D_j$ is $\beta_{D_j,\mathcal F}$, and naturality makes these commute with the cocone maps and with diagram arrows. Composing maps out of the vertices with these isomorphisms gives inverse bijections between cocones, so the colimit universal property holds in the other variable too. Finite coproduct preservation gives additivity by the biproduct calculation of step 1; cokernel preservation gives right exactness, as also explicitly asserted in [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-closed]. This proves clause 2 by its explicit right adjoint.

source.place: Closedness paragraph; explicit adjunction from det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-closed.proof.md

proof.text: Finally specialize to $\mathcal A=\mathrm{Ab}$ with its coefficient tensor $\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$. The specialization and its unit are stated in [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure]: the displayed construction is the sheafified objectwise $\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$ and $a(\underline{\mathbf Z})$ is the constant sheaf $\underline{\mathbf Z}$. Thus the final assertion is the same construction at this coefficient category.

source.place: Ab paragraph and final specialization sentence
